intro: Guatemalan culture is rich in Maya weaving, markets and festivals.

chapters.title: Weaving
text: Maya women weave huipiles (blouses) whose patterns show their home village. Chichicastenango's market is one of the most colourful in the Americas.

chapters.title: Food
text: Pepián (a spicy stew), tamales and black beans with tortillas are staples.
